posts.title: Coloring
posts.description: I've been coloring a LOT lately. Some of it is less than perfect. Some of it is closer to good. But all of it is fun. And I'm branching out. I've started creating single word search puzzles where the only letters used are the ones in the target word. Yes, they are as much fun as they sound. posts.title: I wrote that
posts.description: I have a Discord server just for me, and sometimes I drop lines in there and sometimes they're just complaints with no substance, and then sometimes... Sometimes you find a book that just sweeps you off your feet and you must keep reading because to stop reading would be to lose the magic of the words leaping off the page and directly into your brain. To stop reading would be to lose the character

posts.title: Tooth-hurty
posts.description: What is the best time to go to the dentist? Yeah, I went there. I did not realize how much I touched my face at work until the left half of my jaw was swollen up like a squished baseball from an infection in a tooth.
